You think I am mad, but I am only nervous. Illness made my senses stronger, especially my hearing. I hear everything in heaven and on earth. Listen, and judge how calmly I tell you this. I loved the old man who lived with me. He never hurt me, and I wanted none of his money. But a cloudy film covered his pale blue eye. That vulture's eye made my blood turn cold. I had to get free of it.

last_attempts_log.asr_text: At midnight, for seven nights, I slowly opened his door. You should have seen my patience. He never even moved. Then I let one thin ray escape from my lantern, but I always found that eye shut. I could not act. I hated his eye, not him. Every morning, I kindly asked about his night's sleep. On night eight, I almost laughed at my own cleverness. Then my thumb slipped on the catch of my lantern.

A neighbor had heard a scream from the house.
